items.source: Default implementation of RepositoryInvokerFactory to inspect the requested repository type and create a matching RepositoryInvoker that suits the repository best.
items.translation: RepositoryInvokerFactory 的默认实现，用于检查请求的仓库类型并创建一个最适合该仓库的匹配 RepositoryInvoker。

items.source: Support classes for integration of the repository programming model with 3rd party frameworks.
items.translation: 支持将仓库编程模型与第三方框架集成的辅助类。

items.source: Uses of RepositoryInvokerFactory in org.springframework.data.repository.support
items.translation: RepositoryInvokerFactory 在 org.springframework.data.repository.support 包中的用途
